'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello again! The fairs worked well, business is booming! I was gonna make a little gift for you, but my men were intercepted by Killa and his gang. I heard they're all dressed up in Christmas clothes and partying, so I organized a new route through Ultra while they're busy, but things didn't really go according to plan. I put a lot of money into this, and a lot of deals might go south because of Killa. So, you down to help me out? If you can get rid of that psycho and his stupid friends, I'll owe you big! Just make sure you do this at night, cause they're not gonna let you anywhere near them in the daytime.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and neutralize [[Killa]] in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Interchange]]
* Eliminate 10 [[Scavs]] with festive masks in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Interchange]]

==Rewards==
* +16,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 190,000 Roubles
** 199,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 218,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Death Shadow lightweight armored mask]]
* 2× [[Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Black)]]
{{quote|You got him? You sure? He took down plenty of my guys... But if it's clear now, that means no one's gonna stop us from making cash anymore. As promised, here's a little something for you. Consider it a Christmas present.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill [[Killa]] and 10 [[Scavs]] wearing festive masks in the time period between 22:00 and 10:00.

The festive masks are:
* [[Astronomer mask]]
* [[Aybolit mask]]
* [[Cipollino mask]]
* [[Fox mask]]
* [[Grinch mask]]
* [[Hare mask]]
* [[Hockey player mask (Brawler)]]
* [[Hockey player mask (Captain)]]
* [[Hockey player mask (Quiet)]]
* [[Rooster mask]]
